name: dobe_leanback_key9
desc: keep everything identical: pose, head angle, size, position, colors, stripes, ears, snout, body, arm, drips, rendering and line weight. Only adjust the face naturally, not as a symbol: the eye is closed because the cheek is raised; the closed eye is a thin slanted line following the eyelid shape, lower eyelid pushed up by a slightly fuller cheek with a soft highlight on the cheek. Lips very slightly parted, a thin dark gap at the front of the mouth, no teeth. The mouth line lifts slightly at its end with a short separate cheek fold a little apart from it, like the reference. A thin strand of pink goo hangs from the chin. Quiet amused look.
